acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-batch-check accepts a merge whose only non-derivable path is a declared generated file reproduced byte-identically by its declared generator at the merge tree, with a test; or docs/DOGFOOD.md documents the pre-push recipe and dogfood-change warns before push
a hostile test: a hand-edited generated file at a merge still fails merge-resolution-unbound
body: Observed 2026-10-16 on PR #952 (V1-1460, head 028f6f3f9, BASE b1ee552b3). The lane merged origin/main after #941 landed; the only conflict was the generated docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv, resolved with `make spec-requirements`. dogfood-batch-check from a fresh clone failed merge-resolution-unbound count=1 at the merge (git cannot re-derive the file from the two parents). The suggested repair (redo the merge with -X ours/theirs and commit the regeneration as its own sealed change) rewrites a pushed branch, so the orchestrator had to open a replacement PR. This recurs whenever two lanes add requirement rows (#927, #952). Expected: either batch-check recognizes a generated file whose content equals the generator's output at the merge tree (declared generator, e.g. make spec-requirements) as a derivable resolution, or the lane charter/DOGFOOD documents the -X theirs + separate regeneration recipe at merge time so the failure is caught before push. Actual: unbound, repair needs a new branch.
title: dogfood-batch-check: a merge of main whose only conflict is a generated file (REQUIREMENTS.tsv) is merge-resolution-unbound; the only repair rewrites the pushed branch
